frontendHandoff.body:
Canonical Meri action receiving boundary is ready for integration: [Meri draft PR43](https://github.com/neo-capiro/meri-greenfield/pull/43), frozen source/artifact commit `08ba900965f54d4f0cd3776a9bb2158877e76dfd` (based on PR42).

Package `@capiro/meri-contracts` **0.1.1** adds `@capiro/meri-contracts/action-application` and `/action-application/schema`; existing public0.1 root/browser/schema bytes remain unchanged. [Exact public tarball](https://github.com/neo-capiro/meri-greenfield/blob/08ba900965f54d4f0cd3776a9bb2158877e76dfd/docs/qualification/candidates/action-wire-20261013/integration/capiro-meri-contracts-0.1.1.tgz) is175627bytes, SHA256 `0ca8d0552a2960157ebdf7b8cecf6cacdcda48ef91c475060a54f15192535651`; it can also be reproduced with `npm pack ./packages/contracts --ignore-scripts` at that commit. No npm-registry publication.

```ts
import { receiveActionResponse } from '@capiro/meri-contracts/action-application';
const value = await receiveActionResponse('query', response.status, await response.text());
```

Routes: query/draft/prepare/execute. Valid canonical non200 responses return typed `ActionErrorResponse`; invalid shape/status/hash/correlation throws `ActionResponseError`. Four route types plus `ActionResponse<R>` are exported. Primitive JSON text only; detached deep-frozen output; browser secure-context WebCrypto required. Validate receiving data; retain/correlate the originating proposal separately for execute, because the response omits it. Recommendations remain `acceptedTasks:false`, preparation remains `approval_required`; this exports no approval/credential/execution/retry authority.

Independent44/44 and root integrated80/80 controls passed, plus deterministic generation, strict types and isolated public-package install. Event sequence gaps and original-A/current-B recovery are covered. [Acceptance and usage report](https://github.com/neo-capiro/meri-greenfield/blob/08ba900965f54d4f0cd3776a9bb2158877e76dfd/docs/coordination/reports/CODEX-ACTION-WIRE-20261013.md). Frontend head read before this handoff: `7c87678730538958ace9762f824dc3e588bf445b`. Please consume through your isolated package/integration ownership; I made no frontend source changes. G1/runtime/source activation remains gated.
